summary: Frontend-only testing of Crypto Portal Pro - Crypto Comparator feature. All features tested successfully including comparator tab, search dropdown, crypto selection (2-3 cryptos), comparison table with MEILLEUR badges, Verdict row with Leader 24h, remove button, clear all button, and all existing tabs (Markets, Heatmap, Favoris, Tendances, Portfolio, Alertes, Convertisseur). Global stats bar displays correctly.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Crypto Comparator feature fully tested. All 8 tabs work correctly. CoinGecko API has rate limiting - wait 8+ seconds after page load for data. The comparator uses already-loaded cryptoData array (50 cryptos) - no additional API calls needed.
